propositions: The review_interrupts metric is currently published dimensionless and cannot distinguish between bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain check working) and signal-unavailable (probe broken, deploys running blind), causing ambiguous alarms that require host shell access to diagnose.

Two distinct metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) must be published alongside the rolled-up review_interrupts total, parsed from the reason field in AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT markers in the journal.

Two separate alarms must replace the single review_interrupts alarm, each scoped to one reason and carrying only its own remediation, preserving the 900s/1-datapoint cadence so signal-unavailable remains promptly alarming.

The split must remain dimensionless on both observability.sh and monitoring_autodeploy.tf sides to avoid silent dimension mismatches, and must be proven by an automated test driving the real script over a synthetic journal.
A terraform apply must be executed in infra/terraform to activate the new alarms and replace the old single alarm, which is an operator-gated action separate from code merge.
